items.title: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) Ships PCIe Gen 6 Servers, Is It 57% Below Fair Value?
items.summary: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) has begun shipping new AMD EPYC based all flash storage servers that support the PCIe Gen 6 standard. These products target AI scale data, analytics and high throughput storage workloads. For investors watching Super Micro Computer, the recent launch of PCIe Gen 6 storage arrives during a tough stretch in the share price. The stock is down about 34% on the 90 day share price return and roughly 25% on the 30 day share price return as legal questions and sector...

items.title: Was Nvidia’s strong report a clearing event for the wider chip sector?
items.summary: Investing.com -- It’s too early to call the report a clearing event. As of 9:07 AM ET on Nov 18, 2026, the market is closed until 9:30 AM ET, so no regular-session reaction exists yet. The evidence so far is premarket and overseas trading, and it points to a relief bounce on top of unresolved problems.
